 Weather agency BMKG forecasts light rain across most of Indonesia
 November 14, 2026 11:01 GMT+700 
 A number of motorists brave the rain in Makassar, South Sulawesi, on Tuesday (Oct 24, 2023). Most parts of Makassar began to be drenched by light rain, while the Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) Region IV Makassar forecast that the rainy season would only arrive in mid-November 2023. ANTARA FOTO/Arnas Padda/aww. (ANTARA/ARNAS PADDA/FAUZUL AZHIM) 
 A number of motorists brave the rain in Makassar, South Sulawesi, on Tuesday (Oct 24, 2023). Most parts of Makassar began to be drenched by light rain, while the Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) Region IV Makassar forecast that the rainy season would only arrive in mid-November 2023. ANTARA FOTO/Arnas Padda/aww. (ANTARA/ARNAS PADDA/FAUZUL AZHIM)
 Jakarta (ANTARA) - Indonesia's Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) forecasts light rain across most parts of the country on Saturday.
 BMKG weather forecaster Miftah Ali said in Jakarta on Saturday that light rain is expected in Banda Aceh, Medan, Pekanbaru, Jambi, Bengkulu, Palembang, Pangkal Pinang, Bandar Lampung, Jakarta, Bandung, Yogyakarta, Surabaya, and Mataram.
 Light rain is also forecast for Pontianak, Palangka Raya, Tanjung Selor, Makassar, Mamuju, Palu, Gorontalo, Manado, Jayapura, Merauke, Sorong, Ambon, and Ternate.
 Ali cautioned that rain accompanied by lightning is expected in Padang, Tanjung Pinang, Semarang, Banjarmasin, and Nabire.
 Moderate rain is forecast in Serang and Jayawijaya, he added.
 On the occasion, Ali reminded the public to always be alert to extreme weather that can occur during the transition between seasons. BMKG also highlighted the need to adjust activities and travel plans to the existing weather conditions.
